limitations: Only two identical hard-core bosons on a unit-hopping cocktail-party graph and an initially matched nonedge
Pairing means occupancy of any nonedge of the deleted matching, not persistent occupancy of the original nonedge
No disorder, decoherence, loss, nonuniform hopping, many-particle or geometric-dimer assertion
Historical priority against an unindexed explicit dynamical formula is not conclusively settled

scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Orthogonal sign-even reduction and unsigned-incidence singular values, plus exact Markov lumping
scientific_integrity.theorem: Exact formula for pairing probability, sharp all-time leakage asymptotic, and classical comparison
scientific_integrity.verification: 36 direct full-matrix quantum/classical tests, 9 asymptotic finite tests

title: Uniform-in-time anti-edge pairing of two hard-core quantum walkers on cocktail-party networks
